title: Abdollahi–Akbari–Maimani nilpotency conjecture for non-commuting graphs
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite non-abelian nilpotent group, and let $H$ be a group. For a finite non-abelian group $K$, let $\Gamma_K$ be the graph whose vertices are the non-central elements of $K$, with two vertices adjacent when they do not commute. **Abdollahi–Akbari–Maimani nilpotency conjecture.** If

$$
\Gamma_G\cong\Gamma_H,
$$

then $H$ is nilpotent. This conjecture asks whether nilpotency can be recovered from the non-commuting graph. The source states that it remains open, although it is proved for finite AC-groups when $|Z(G)|\geq|Z(H)|$ and substantial partial results are known.
source_name: Valentina Grazian and Carmine Monetta, “A conjecture related to the nilpotency of groups with isomorphic non-commuting graphs”, arXiv:2302.01770 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.01770

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2023).
